about_the_game:
Overview
Step into the exciting world of professional wrestling management with this UI-driven simulation game. Create and simulate your own wrestling shows, book matches by selecting participants and outcomes, and watch your promotion grow as you compete against rival companies. Manage every aspect of your wrestling federation with intuitive controls designed to provide a smooth and engaging experience.

Key Features

  • Create and simulate wrestling shows with a simple, clean UI interface

  • Book matches by choosing wrestlers and match winners

  • Progress through days as your promotion evolves and reacts to your decisions

  • Compete against AI-controlled rival companies with their own strategies

  • Manage wrestler rosters, storylines, and match outcomes for maximum entertainment

  • Customize your experience by creating and sharing databases for different game scenarios.

Why Play?
Experience the thrill of running your own wrestling promotion from the ground up. Whether you're a wrestling fan or a strategy game enthusiast, this game offers a unique blend of management and storytelling, wrapped in an accessible interface.
